data.name: ROAR
data.detailed_description:
🦁 ROAR

YOU ARE NOT THE HUNTER

🌍 A Wildlife Paradise Hiding a Classified Experiment

ROAR is a cinematic first-person survival horror game set in 2022 within Kijani Nyota Private Conservancy, a remote wildlife reserve in northern Kenya once celebrated as a global model for lion conservation, advanced genetic research, and luxury eco-tourism.

Behind its pristine visitor centers, safari vehicles, veterinary laboratories, and polished conservation reports, the reserve concealed a far more dangerous truth.

🧬 PROJECT NEMEAN

A classified field experiment created to study:

  • Fear response

  • Predator decision-making

  • Coordinated hunting behavior

  • Neurological adaptation

  • Social learning in lions

📸 YOU ARE ADAM

You play as Adam, an independent wildlife photographer who arrives at Kijani Nyota after booking what appears to be an exclusive luxury safari experience.

But from the moment you arrive, something is wrong.

  • The lodge is nearly abandoned.

  • The radios are silent.

  • The maps do not match the terrain.

  • Entire sectors are missing.

  • And when night falls, the lions begin to move.

They do not attack blindly.

They watch.
They wait.
They surround.
They choose the perfect moment.

🦁 SURVIVAL IS THE ONLY OPTION

In ROAR, survival is not about fighting monsters.

It is about:

  • Reading the environment

  • Controlling panic

  • Managing stamina

  • Conserving flashlight batteries

  • Listening to the world around you

  • Understanding that every sound in the grass may be your final warning

There is no traditional health system.

If a lion catches you, you die.

📖 THE PUBLIC STORY

For years, Kijani Nyota operated as a respected conservation initiative dedicated to:

  • Protecting lions

  • Studying wildlife diseases

  • Supporting local communities

  • Reducing human-predator conflict

That was the public story.

The truth was something else entirely.

🧠 FEAR IS NOT REMOVED. FEAR IS REASSIGNED.

Project NEMEAN did not seek to create a mindless aggressive animal.

That would have been easy to provoke, easy to predict, and easy to contain.

Instead, NEMEAN pursued something far more dangerous:

  • A predator capable of patience

  • A predator that retains its intelligence

  • A predator that preserves its instincts

  • A predator that learns to ignore natural fear responses

  • A predator that reacts to specific environmental signals as commands

The first major subject was designated:

L-01 / ATLAS

After a fatal incident inside a supposedly secure test range, one sentence entered the archives:

“Subject did not charge blindly. Subject waited.”

That sentence became the foundation of everything that followed.

🎮 CORE GAMEPLAY SYSTEMS

ROAR is built around vulnerability, tension, and systemic survival.

You will need to:

  • Manage stamina carefully instead of running blindly

  • Use your flashlight without exposing yourself

  • Hide in tall grass, abandoned buildings, vehicles, and terrain shadows

  • Read animal behavior as environmental warning signs

  • Track footprints, blood stains, claw marks, and distant sounds

  • Explore abandoned lodges, ranger camps, veterinary facilities, watchtowers, and hidden laboratories

  • Uncover the truth behind Project NEMEAN

🦁 ADVANCED PREDATOR AI

The lions in ROAR are not conventional enemies.

They can:

  • Track sound and movement

  • Use darkness and tall grass to remain concealed

  • Approach from multiple directions

  • Retreat instead of attacking immediately

  • Wait until you are exhausted or exposed

  • Adapt to light, noise, terrain, and player behavior

Sometimes you will hear them before you see them.

Sometimes you will see nothing at all.

⭐ KEY FEATURES

  • Cinematic first-person survival horror

  • Set in a private Kenyan wildlife reserve in 2022

  • Advanced lion AI based on stalking, flanking, and patience

  • No traditional health system

  • Stamina and panic management

  • Flashlight and battery mechanics

  • Stealth-based survival

  • Environmental tracking and investigation

  • Dynamic wildlife ecosystem

  • Abandoned facilities and secret underground laboratories

  • Deep interconnected narrative

  • Psychological horror built on silence, tension, and vulnerability

🛠 TECHNICAL INFORMATION

data.short_description: A cinematic first-person survival horror game where you explore a remote Kenyan wildlife reserve and survive intelligent lions that stalk, surround, and wait for the perfect moment to strike. Manage stamina, light, and panic as you uncover a classified predator experiment.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K OR AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super OR AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • VR Support: Not Supported
  • Additional Notes: Designed for 1080p at Low–Medium settings. SSD required.

  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 OR AMD Radeon RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • VR Support: Not Supported
  • Additional Notes: Designed for 1440p at High settings with Lumen and Nanite enabled

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains scenes of realistic violence and intense psychological horror. Players may encounter attacks by wild animals, depictions of injury, blood, and occasional corpses. The game features a dark and tense atmosphere that may be disturbing to some players. There is no sexual content, sexual violence, or depiction of drug and alcohol abuse.
